findings.evidence: "The fetcher needs bash 4+." gives no symptom or reason
findings.fix: Say why it matters: "The fetcher needs bash 4+ (declare -A). macOS /bin/bash is 3.2 and fails with 'declare: -A: invalid option'. Run it with a Homebrew bash."

findings.evidence: Description is about 800 characters and is heavy on internals ("bump rubric_version, spec_sha or profile_version", "profiles") instead of what the user wants
findings.fix: Refresh the specs that skill-judge scores against. Re-fetches the pinned Agent Skills docs and skills-ref validator from agentskills.io, and the Claude Code skills, sub-agents and plugins-reference pages from code.claude.com. Reports which rules changed and updates the judge rubric or the command/agent profiles to match. Use when the maintainer of this repo asks to refresh, sync or update the agentskills spec, the skill-judge rubric, or the vendored Claude Code subagent or command docs, or asks whether upstream skill-format rules changed since the last pin, even without naming the fetch scripts. Works only from a checkout of this repo. Not for writing, judging, or validating a skill (use skill-judge or skills-ref).

findings.evidence: The rare structure-repair procedure ("Update the fetcher's source map, fixture, and tests ... --pages-dir ...") is loaded inline on every run
findings.fix: Move it to references/structure-change.md and gate it with: "Read references/structure-change.md only when structure_changed is true or rubric-check reports a broken anchor"

findings.evidence: "Update the fetcher's source map, fixture, and tests for added or removed pages; add or delete the matching reference copy; remap every affected rubric source" is a fragile multi-file edit with no exact commands or order
findings.fix: Give exact steps: edit the FILES array in scripts/fetch-spec.sh, copy <page>.mdx from --pages-dir into tests/skills/agentskills-research/fixtures/upstream/docs/, run `bash tests/skills/agentskills-research/test-fetch-spec.sh`, re-run fetch-spec.sh, then run rubric-check

findings.evidence: 13 should-trigger and 8 should-not-trigger queries. Several negatives are easy and share no keywords ("write me a new skill from scratch", "bump the version of a vendored dependency")
findings.fix: Cut the positives to 10. Replace the easy negatives with near-misses such as "summarize what changed in the Claude Code subagents docs this week" and "update the rubric's D3 bands to be stricter" (rubric edit with no refresh)

findings.evidence: Repair branch says "record the pending commit without performing it", but step 6 (line 37) says the repair branch must build, run rubric-check and "Commit only after both checks succeed"
findings.fix: Make one rule for both: either "Repair branch: run build_plugins.py and rubric-check, then report the pending commit without committing", or let step 6 commit in both branches and remove "without performing it"
